questions.question: Which user made a post titled 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?' and how much is the reputation of the user?
questions.evidence: "Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?" is the Title of post; user refers to DisplayName;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.DisplayName, T1.Reputation FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T2.Title = 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?'

questions.question: Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
questions.evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(UserId where UpVotes = 0 and Score BETWEEN 5 and 10))*100, (COUNT(UserId where Score BETWEEN 5 and 10));
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.UpVotes = 0, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100/ COUNT(T1.Id) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

questions.question: Calculate the ratio of votes in 2010 and 2011.
questions.evidence: DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010), COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011)) FROM votes;
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010', 1, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011', 1, 0)) FROM votes

questions.question: How many comments were added to the post with the highest score?
questions.evidence: the highest score refers to MAX(Score);
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId GROUP BY T1.Id ORDER BY T1.Score DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Provide the text of the latest 10 comments to the post with the title 'Analysing wind data with R' and the display name of the user who left it.
questions.evidence: the latest comment refers to MAX(CreationDate);
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.Text, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.PostId WHERE T2.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY T1.CreationDate DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: How many posts does the user csgillespie own?
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

questions.question: Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and view count from posts posted by Amos.
questions.evidence: calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Mornington'), SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Amos'));
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.DisplayName = 'Mornington', T3.ViewCount, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.DisplayName = 'Amos', T3.ViewCount, 0)) AS diff FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.PostId
